messages:
maria: uploaded a fresh prototype called 'scope swap' for the spend dashboard. link: https://redwood.design/prototypes/scope-swap :eyes:
aj: checked it out. great momentum. couple quick flags: the scope toggle is visible but not clear which sub-controls remain sticky (time range, token denom?).
sam: major +1. when folks flip org/project it currently resets the denom to USD — super annoying for token-first users. can we persist denom per user/session? :thinking:
kyle: accessibility nit: legend chips in dark mode dip to ~3.8:1 contrast. change BG from token-neutral-200 to token-neutral-300. also the toggle lacks an explicit aria-label; screen readers announce "button" only.
olivia: invoice CTA is in the global header now. prefer contextual placement: if project scope is active, show "Download project invoice"; if org scope, show "Download org invoice". non-admins should see a disabled state + tooltip explaining permission.
maria: easy to make invoice CTA contextual. aria example for toggle: ```html
<Toggle aria-label="Scope: organization or project" role="switch" data-testid="scope-toggle" />
```
aj: layout question: option A puts token breakdown in the left rail (sticky) and main chart on the right; option B keeps breakdown as a compact card above the chart. A helps side-by-side comparison when scanning projects; B is denser for mobile. preferences?
sam: I vote A on desktop, but have a collapsible card for mobile widths. we should persist collapse state per user so it doesn't reopen every visit.
kyle: chart feature ask: micro-legend to toggle between "consumption (tokens)" and "cost (USD)" inline. do it client-side to avoid heavy backend queries; use cached exchange/rate per-range. also ensure keyboard focus order includes legend toggles.
maria: agree on client-side transform with cached rates. add a small CTA: "What is token denom?" which opens a compact tooltip explaining denom mapping, rounding, and billing unit. copy should be simple and link to docs.
olivia: copy tweak: change "Token breakdown" => "Usage by model & token type" to help support triage. invoice tooltip copy: "Invoices are generated within 24 hours after billing close."
billing-bot: note: invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for non-billing-admins. UI should map these to friendly states: "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted" with next steps. avoid showing raw 404.
aj: rule reminder: never surface raw error codes. convert to user-friendly copy and suggested actions.
kyle: mobile perf/layout: when scope=org and project list length > 8, collapse into a searchable dropdown instead of a long vertical list. reduces layout thrash and memory usage.
sam: performance hook: debounce chart re-render on rapid scope toggles by 200ms to avoid analytics thrash and repeated heavy renders. also lazy-load detailed breakdown only after chart renders.
maria: action items: 1) aria & contrast fixes (kyle) 2) invoice CTA contextual + disabled tooltip for non-admins (olivia) 3) persist token denom per-user/session (sam) 4) left-rail breakdown on desktop + collapsible card on mobile (aj + design) 5) client-side unit toggle and token explanation tooltip (maria) 6) map invoice API errors to friendly states (aj + billing-bot). I'll update Figma and push a small A/B prototype for desktop by EOD.
aj: when A/B is live we'll do a quick hallway test (3 ppl) and iterate. :thumbsup:
